### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, touching **34** documentable anchor(s).

**40** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5448585d87246c0d57fdbbf422ece35c4c025241`.

⛔ **14** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **23** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5448585d87246c0d57fdbbf422ece35c4c025241` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `4f2e978b91c68134bb8d69bccec67cd0ae0b43f6` — the merge of head `fca3704b30db0f368af03995d4c790a1cd05e007` into base `5448585d87246c0d57fdbbf422ece35c4c025241`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 4f2e978b91c68134bb8d69bccec67cd0ae0b43f6 && git checkout 4f2e978b91c68134bb8d69bccec67cd0ae0b43f6
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 5448585d87246c0d57fdbbf422ece35c4c025241 fca3704b30db0f368af03995d4c790a1cd05e007 && git checkout -B drift-repro 5448585d87246c0d57fdbbf422ece35c4c025241 && git merge --no-ff fca3704b30db0f368af03995d4c790a1cd05e007

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5448585d87246c0d57fdbbf422ece35c4c025241
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 5448585d87246c0d57fdbbf422ece35c4c025241` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `fca3704b30db0f368af03995d4c790a1cd05e007`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/role-change-granted-set.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/role-change-granted-set.test.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-before-hook.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-after-hook.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-auth-instance.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-member.object.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/{en,zh-CN,ja-JP,es-ES}.objects.generated.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/transfer-ownership-action-copy.test.ts + packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-delivery-outcome.ts (the #27843 precedent, PR #27902 f552fa81), packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/organization-delete.ts (`ORGANIZATION_ADMIN_SET_NAMES`), packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts (`outcomeMessages` / `successMessage` fallback) (`.changeset/27862-role-change-names-granted-set.md` is a prose face: the lane seat's ACCEPT)

Owed on the declaration face alone; the diff touches no `packages/spec/src/**` and no governed path, so the tier is `TIER_DEFAULT`, written by the lane seat.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Declaration corrected.** The dev declared `Clause-②: no` at `a574295a`, reading #27843 as precedent. That precedent (PR #27902, `f552fa81`) declared `Clause-②: yes (widening)` for the same shape (a success answer gains `outcome` plus copy keys). This PR widens the same way: `POST /organization/update-member-role`'s success answer gains `outcome: 'permission_set_granted'` and `grantedPermissionSet: { name, label }`, and the two `sys_member` actions gain `outcomeMessages`. Head `fca3704b` changes only the changeset line to `yes (widening: …)`; the claim (6520476174) is amended to match. **The PR body still reads `Clause-②: no`: the relay cannot edit a PR body, so this record is the correction — read `yes (widening)` for this PR.**
- **Accept set unchanged.** Nothing a caller sends is accepted or refused differently: the before hook only reads; the after hook only adds members to a success answer. What is granted is unchanged: `plugin-security`'s reconciler stays the one writer, and `plugin-security` is not in the diff.
- **When the members appear.** Only when (a) the path is `update-member-role`, (b) the before hook stashed the pair's org-admin grants, (c) the answer is an object and not an `APIError`, and (d) a set among `ORGANIZATION_ADMIN_SET_NAMES` is held after and was not before. Admin → owner (already held), demotions, member → external and refusals answer as before. Pinned case by case.
- **No disclosure beyond the caller's reach.** The before hook reads the target by `memberId` under the system read context before better-auth authorizes, but it only stashes; a refused request gets no stamp and the stash is deleted in the after hook. A successful caller is already authorized for that member, and learns only the name and catalog label of an org-admin set it just caused to be granted.
- **Fails toward silence.** Every read is in `try`/`catch`; a failed read, a missing member or a lost stash leaves the vendor's answer byte-for-byte (pinned: throwing before-read, throwing after-read).
- **Console copy.** `outcomeMessages` is an existing `ActionSchema` member; the action picks the entry named by the answer's `outcome` and falls back to `successMessage` otherwise (action.zod.ts). Both actions call the same route, so both carry the entry. The generated translations carry the new key in all four locales.
- Wrong: none found beyond the declaration, corrected above.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset`: `@objectstack/plugin-auth` and `@objectstack/platform-objects` `patch`, `Clause-②: yes (widening: …)` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, line-initial. A non-protocol widening ships `patch` (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3), matching #27902. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right: no key an author can write changes; `outcomeMessages` already exists in the spec.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **PR body vs changeset.** Body `no`, changeset and claim `yes (widening)`. The queue gate reads the claim; the record above carries the correction. If a PR-body guard reds on the mismatch, that is a real finding for the lane seat, not to be worked around.
- **Cost.** Two system reads before and one or two after, on this one route only. Proportionate.
- Check-runs at this head: not complete when read. Landing waits for all green.

### ④ Design judgment

- **`role-change-granted-set.ts`:** measuring the grant (before/after read of the pair's rows) instead of inferring it from the role is the right call: posture decides which set is granted (ADR-0105 D4), and the reconciler may decide none. It mirrors #27843's shape and placement in the global hooks, keeps the reconciler the one writer, and fails silent rather than wrong.
- **`sys-member.object.ts`:** the copy names the set by its catalog label, so a posture's `(no record bypass)` variant reads correctly.
- **Tests:** two grant paths, three no-grant paths, two failure paths, the unlabelled set, and another route untouched; two ablations shown red by the thread.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-rvombf`
Reviewed-by: `session_016WV4czuTWNgKR22fKv7jia (lane seat)`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Seat ACCEPT · PR #28086 · head `fca3704b30db0f368af03995d4c790a1cd05e007` · 2026-10-30T12:29Z

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 把成员升为管理员或所有者时，角色变更接口会顺带说明自动授予了哪个权限集（`outcome: 'permission_set_granted'` + `grantedPermissionSet: { name, label }`），控制台的「修改角色」「设为所有者」提示随之显示：「成员角色已更新。新角色还授予了权限集 ×××」（#27862）。
- **为什么改：** 以前只提示「Member role updated」，管理员事后在用户的权限集页看到一个没人显式分配的集合。
- **风险与回滚：** 只读、不改授予逻辑（授予仍由 `plugin-security` 的协调器唯一写入）；任何读取失败都静默回落为原样回答。回滚即还原 plugin-auth 的两处钩子与新模块、platform-objects 的文案。
- **先看：** `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/role-change-granted-set.ts`。
- **两分钟验证：** 在控制台把一个普通成员改为 admin，看成功提示是否点名权限集；再从 admin 改为 owner，应只显示原提示。
- **需要你做的：** 无（Tier S；契约复核 PASS，按本期落地授权由席位落地）。

## 席位核对

- **Shape:** draft → main, `Fixes #27862`. 13 files (+520/−10): plugin-auth (new `role-change-granted-set.ts` + test, before/after hook wiring, `AuthManager.roleChangeGrantDeps`), platform-objects (`sys-member.object.ts` outcome copy, four generated translation bundles, one copy pin), one changeset. `check-governed-merges --pr 28086`: NOT governed.
- **Premise:** re-measured by the thread on `main`: the route answered the member row from the adapter; the org-admin grant is written by `plugin-security`'s `sys_member` middleware inside the same request; the action toasted fixed copy.
- **File surface:** amended in the claim before the push (plugin-auth after-hook + platform-objects copy; `plugin-security` untouched — confirmed, it is not in the diff).
- **Contract review:** `Clause-②: yes (widening)` on the changeset and (amended) the claim. **Correction to the PR body:** its `Clause-②: no` line is wrong and cannot be edited through the relay; read `yes (widening: update-member-role's success answer gains outcome 'permission_set_granted' and grantedPermissionSet; the two sys_member actions gain outcomeMessages)`, as the #27843 / PR #27902 precedent declared. `TIER_DEFAULT` record by the lane seat, **PASS**, comment 6522494596, at this head.
- **Declarations:** `Metadata-protocol: none`; both packages `patch`. `Skills-docs:` per the PR body.
- **Gate check-runs on this head:** 48 total, 35 success, 13 skipped by the path filter, 0 failed (PR-body guards green). `mergeable_state: clean`.
- **Landing:** Tier S, under the maintainer's landing grant for this term (2026-10-29 22:05Z, seat thread). Ready + auto-merge through the relay.

**ACCEPT**
